rules.label: Disallowed category
rules.message: This category is not eligible for reimbursement under IRAS Regulations 26/27. Talk to finance if you believe this is a special case.

rules.label: Future-dated claim
rules.message: The expense date is in the future — submit again after the expense actually happens.

rules.label: Missing receipt over S$50
rules.message: A receipt image is required for claims above S$50.

rules.label: Client Entertainment without justification
rules.message: Client entertainment claims must include a business justification — IRAS requires this on the record.

rules.label: Client Entertainment without named client
rules.message: Client entertainment claims must name the client company and contacts present.

rules.label: Training without justification
rules.message: Training claims must describe how the course supports your role — required for IRAS deductibility.

rules.label: Late-night transport
rules.message: Late-night transport over S$25 needs a quick manager check (verifies it's a genuine OT return).

rules.label: Small meal — within allowance
rules.message: Within the standard meal allowance — no manager review needed.

rules.label: Local transport — within allowance
rules.message: Within the local transport allowance — no manager review needed.

rules.label: Large meal without attendee context
rules.message: Meals over S$50 need a short note on who attended so the approver can confirm it's a working meal.

rules.label: Client Entertainment over S$300
rules.message: Client entertainment over S$300 needs manager review — confirm the attendee list and per-head spend (IRAS).

rules.label: Above auto-approve ceiling
rules.message: Above the auto-approval ceiling of S$500 — manager review required.
